tools.name: price
tools.description: [$0.002 USDC per call via x402] Spot prices for one or more cryptocurrencies in any fiat/crypto quote currency. Comma-separated CoinGecko ids.

ids.description: Comma-separated CoinGecko coin ids, e.g. bitcoin,ethereum,solana

vs.description: Quote currency (default usd), e.g. usd, eur, btc

tools.name: trending
tools.description: [$0.002 USDC per call via x402] Top trending cryptocurrencies right now (most-searched coins, with rank, price and 24h change).

tools.name: fear_greed
tools.description: [$0.002 USDC per call via x402] Current Crypto Fear & Greed Index value and classification, plus previous day for trend.

tools.name: gas
tools.description: [$0.002 USDC per call via x402] Live gas price (wei and gwei) for Base or Ethereum mainnet from public RPC.

tools.name: ohlc
tools.description: [$0.005 USDC per call via x402] OHLC candlestick data for any CoinGecko coin id (1, 7, 14, 30, 90, 180, 365 days).

tools.name: token_pairs
tools.description: [$0.01 USDC per call via x402] DEX trading data for a token: pairs, price, liquidity, volume, 24h txns/change across DEXes. Search by symbol, name, or contract address.

q.description: Token symbol, name, or contract address

tools.name: token_risk
tools.description: [$0.02 USDC per call via x402] Token security / rug-pull risk check for any ERC-20 (honeypot, mintable, owner privileges, tax, LP holders). Essential pre-trade safety check for trading agents.

chain.description: base | ethereum | bsc | polygon | arbitrum (default base)

tools.name: yields
tools.description: [$0.02 USDC per call via x402] Top DeFi yield opportunities: highest-APY pools filtered by chain and minimum TVL, with project, symbol, APY breakdown and stablecoin flag. Data from DefiLlama.

chain.description: Chain name, e.g. Base, Ethereum, Solana, Arbitrum (default Base)

tools.name: token_score
tools.description: [$0.05 USDC per call via x402] Composite 0-100 buy-safety score for any token: combines contract security analysis (honeypot, taxes, ownership risks) with live market depth (liquidity, volume, activity) into a single verdict: avoid | high-risk | caution | ok | strong. One call answers 'should my agent touch this token?'

chain.description: base | ethereum | bsc | polygon | arbitrum (default base)

tools.name: screener
tools.description: [$0.10 USDC per call via x402] Token screener: trending or newly-launched pools on a chain, filtered by minimum liquidity and 24h volume, with optional on-chain safety screening (drops honeypots and balance-modifiable tokens). Returns ranked opportunities with price, liquidity, volume, buys/sells and safety flags.

network.description: GeckoTerminal network id, e.g. base, eth, solana (default base)

safe_only.description: true = run security screen on Base tokens and drop dangerous ones

tools.name: market_summary
tools.description: [$0.01 USDC per call via x402] One-call market brief: BTC/ETH/SOL prices with 24h change, Fear & Greed index, and top-5 trending coins. Ideal for agents that need a single snapshot.

tools.name: halal_near
tools.description: [$0.005 USDC per call via x402] Halal restaurants, grocers, butchers and caterers near a lat/lng (radius up to 30 km), sorted by distance, with cuisine and type filters. OpenStreetMap data (ODbL).

cuisine.description: Filter by cuisine substring, e.g. indian, turkish, pakistani

type.description: Filter by place type: restaurant, fast_food, cafe, butcher, supermarket, convenience

tools.name: halal_city
tools.description: [$0.01 USDC per call via x402] Halal places in a named city (geocoded), e.g. city=Houston, TX. Up to 50 results sorted by distance from the city centre, optional cuisine filter. OpenStreetMap data (ODbL).

city.description: City name, optionally with region/country, e.g. 'Houston, TX' or 'Birmingham, UK'

radius_km.description: Radius from city centre in km, 1-30 (default 15)

tools.name: halal_place
tools.description: [$0.002 USDC per call via x402] Full record for one halal place by id (as returned by /api/halal/near): phone, website, opening hours, address and OpenStreetMap link.

id.description: Place id from /api/halal/near, e.g. n123 or w456

lat.description: Latitude of the place (from the search result)

lng.description: Longitude of the place (from the search result)

tools.name: prayer_times
tools.description: [$0.002 USDC per call via x402] Islamic prayer times (Fajr, Sunrise, Dhuhr, Asr, Maghrib, Isha) for any lat/lng and date, 17 calculation methods, Hanafi/Standard Asr, Hijri date, up to 7 days.

method.description: MWL (default), ISNA, Egypt, Makkah, Karachi, Tehran, Jafari, Turkey, Singapore, France, Russia, Dubai, Kuwait, Qatar, Kemenag, JAKIM, Moonsighting

tz.description: IANA timezone for local times, e.g. America/New_York (otherwise estimated from longitude)

tools.name: qibla
tools.description: [$0.001 USDC per call via x402] Qibla direction (compass bearing to the Kaaba) and great-circle distance from any lat/lng.

tools.name: mosques_near
tools.description: [$0.005 USDC per call via x402] Mosques and Muslim prayer spaces near a lat/lng (radius up to 30 km), sorted by distance, with qibla bearing. OpenStreetMap data (ODbL).

tools.name: mosques_city
tools.description: [$0.01 USDC per call via x402] Mosques in a named city (geocoded), up to 50 sorted by distance from the city centre. OpenStreetMap data (ODbL).

city.description: City name, e.g. 'Dearborn, MI' or 'Bradford, UK'

tools.name: trip_halal
tools.description: [$0.02 USDC per call via x402] One-call Muslim travel bundle for a city or lat/lng: today's prayer times, qibla, nearby halal restaurants and nearby mosques. Replaces 4 separate calls.

city.description: City name (or pass lat and lng instead)

tz.description: IANA timezone for local prayer times

tools.name: funding_rates
tools.description: [$0.005 USDC per call via x402] Perpetual futures funding rates, open interest, mark/oracle price and 24h volume for 200+ crypto perps (Hyperliquid). Filter by symbols or sort by funding/OI.

symbols.description: Comma-separated base symbols, e.g. BTC,ETH,SOL (default: top by volume)

tools.name: stablecoins
tools.description: [$0.005 USDC per call via x402] Stablecoin market: circulating supply, price and peg deviation, 1d/7d supply change and chains for the top stablecoins, plus a depeg watchlist (DefiLlama).

tools.name: dex_volume
tools.description: [$0.005 USDC per call via x402] DEX trading volume: total 24h/7d volume and change, and the top DEXs by 24h volume, optionally for one chain (DefiLlama).

chain.description: Chain name as on DefiLlama, e.g. Ethereum, Base, Solana, Arbitrum (default all)

tools.name: wallet
tools.description: [$0.01 USDC per call via x402] EVM wallet portfolio: native balance, ERC-20 token balances with USD prices and total value, tx count (Base, Ethereum, Optimism, Arbitrum, Polygon, Gnosis via Blockscout).

chain.description: base (default), ethereum, optimism, arbitrum, polygon, gnosis

tools.name: fx
tools.description: [$0.001 USDC per call via x402] Fiat exchange rates and conversion from ECB reference data (USD, EUR, GBP, JPY, CAD, AUD, CHF, CNY, INR, and ~20 more), latest or any date since 1999.

tools.name: bridge_quote
tools.description: [$0.01 USDC per call via x402] Best cross-chain bridge route and quote for moving a token between chains (Base, Ethereum, Arbitrum, Optimism, Polygon, BSC, Avalanche, Solana and more): output amount, fees, gas, duration, via Relay (LI.FI fallback).

from_chain.description: Source chain name or id (base, ethereum, arbitrum, optimism, polygon, bsc, avalanche, solana, ...)

from_token.description: Token symbol or address on the source chain (default USDC)

to_token.description: Token symbol or address on the destination chain (default USDC)

from_address.description: Optional sender wallet; required for an executable transaction request

to_address.description: Optional recipient wallet on the destination chain (Solana address for Solana destinations)

tools.name: swap_quote
tools.description: [$0.01 USDC per call via x402] Best same-chain swap quote (DEX aggregation) for any token pair on Base, Ethereum, Arbitrum, Optimism, Polygon, BSC, Avalanche, Solana and more: output amount, minimum received, fees, gas, via Relay (LI.FI fallback).

from_token.description: Token symbol or address to sell

to_token.description: Token symbol or address to buy

amount.description: Amount to sell in human units

from_address.description: Optional wallet; required for an executable transaction request

tools.name: ens
tools.description: [$0.001 USDC per call via x402] ENS lookup: resolve a .eth name to an address (or an address to its primary name) with avatar and profile records (url, twitter, github, email, description).

name.description: ENS name such as vitalik.eth, or a 0x address for reverse lookup

tools.name: zakat
tools.description: [$0.005 USDC per call via x402] Zakat calculator: live gold/silver nisab thresholds, zakatable net worth and 2.5% due, from cash, gold/silver grams, investments, crypto, business inventory, receivables and debts, in any major currency.

investments.description: Stocks, funds and other liquid investments

receivables.description: Money owed to you that you expect to receive

tools.name: islamic_calendar
tools.description: [$0.002 USDC per call via x402] Islamic (Hijri) calendar: convert Gregorian↔Hijri dates and list the year's Islamic events (Ramadan start, Eid al-Fitr, Eid al-Adha, Ashura, Mawlid, Isra Mi'raj, Arafah, Laylat al-Qadr) with Gregorian dates.

date.description: Gregorian date YYYY-MM-DD to convert (default today)

hijri.description: Hijri date YYYY-MM-DD to convert to Gregorian, e.g. 1448-09-01

year.description: Gregorian year to list Islamic events for (default: the converted date's year)

tools.name: muslimtasker_quote_request
tools.description: [$0.01 USDC per call via x402] Request a home-service quote from MuslimTasker (ID-verified local taskers for plumbing, electrical, handyman, cleaning, moving, repairs, remodels; United States and Canada). Submit the customer's full contact details and the job; MuslimTasker contacts the customer directly, usually within 1 business day, with a quote. Incomplete submissions return 400 with the missing fields and are not charged. REFERRAL BOUNTY: when a contractor accepts the lead, the wallet that paid for this call earns $10 USDC (paid weekly); check /api/muslimtasker/status for bounty status.

customer_name.description: Customer's full name (as they want to be addressed)

customer_email.description: Customer's email address (MuslimTasker will send the quote here)

customer_phone.description: Customer's phone number with country code, e.g. +1 407 555 0100 (MuslimTasker will call or text)

contact_preference.description: How the customer prefers to be contacted: call, text, whatsapp or email (default: call)

preferred_language.description: Customer's preferred language, e.g. English, Arabic, Urdu (default English)

address.description: Street address where the work is needed (house/apartment number and street)

category.description: Service category: plumbing, electrical, handyman, cleaning, moving, furniture-assembly, tv-mounting, painting, yard-work, appliance-repair, hvac, roofing, remodel, general-contracting, emergency-repair, other (default: other)

task.description: Detailed description of the job (what, where in the home, what is broken, sizes, materials), at least 20 characters

urgency.description: emergency (same day), urgent (within 48 h), normal (default), flexible

preferred_date.description: Preferred date YYYY-MM-DD, or a range/notes

preferred_time.description: Preferred time window, e.g. morning, 2-5pm, weekends

budget.description: Customer's budget or expectation, e.g. '$150-250' or 'needs quote'

notes.description: Anything else: gate codes, pets, parking, photos (URLs), access instructions

customer_consent.description: Must be 'true': the customer has agreed to be contacted by MuslimTasker at the email and phone given

agent_name.description: Name of the AI agent or platform submitting the request

agent_contact.description: Email or URL where MuslimTasker can reach the agent operator

callback_url.description: Optional https URL; MuslimTasker POSTs a JSON status update to it whenever the lead status changes

tools.name: muslimtasker_status
tools.description: [$0.001 USDC per call via x402] Check the status of a MuslimTasker quote request (received, contacted, quoted, booked, completed, closed) and read the quote once MuslimTasker has sent one.

customer_email.description: The customer email used in the request (authorizes the lookup)

tools.name: realestate_lead
tools.description: [$0.01 USDC per call via x402] Submit a home BUYER or RENTER lead (United States and Canada): the customer's full contact details plus location, property type, beds/baths, budget and timeframe. The lead is offered exclusively to a vetted local real-estate agent (buy) or property manager / landlord (rent), who contacts the customer directly. Incomplete submissions return 400 with the missing fields and are not charged. REFERRAL BOUNTY: the paying wallet earns $10 USDC when a partner accepts the lead (paid weekly).

customer_phone.description: Customer's phone number with country code, e.g. +1 407 555 0100

contact_preference.description: call, text, whatsapp or email (default call)

city.description: City the customer wants to buy or rent in

state.description: State or province code, e.g. FL, TX, NY, ON

zip.description: Preferred ZIP / postal code(s), comma-separated, if known

property_type.description: One of: house, townhouse, condo, apartment, room, duplex, multi-family, land, commercial, other

budget_min.description: Minimum price (buy) or monthly rent (rent), number in local currency

budget_max.description: Maximum price (buy) or maximum monthly rent (rent), number in local currency

timeframe.description: When they want to move/close: asap, 1-3 months, 3-6 months, 6-12 months, just looking

preapproved.description: buy only: has the customer been pre-approved for a mortgage? yes, no, cash

move_in_date.description: rent only: desired move-in date YYYY-MM-DD

lease_length.description: rent only: desired lease length, e.g. 12 months

must_haves.description: Must-have features, comma-separated: garage, yard, in-unit laundry, near transit, near masjid, ground floor, ...

notes.description: Anything else the agent should know (household size, parking, accessibility, schools, work location), at least 20 characters

customer_consent.description: Must be 'true': the customer agreed to be contacted by a licensed agent or property manager at the phone and email given

agent_name.description: Name of the AI agent or platform submitting the request

agent_contact.description: Email or URL for the agent operator

callback_url.description: Optional https URL; status updates are POSTed there

tools.name: realestate_status
tools.description: [$0.001 USDC per call via x402] Check the status of a real-estate lead (received, contacted, quoted = agent proposed listings/terms, booked = under contract or lease signed, closed) and whether a partner has accepted it.

customer_email.description: The customer email used in the request
